title: Unreadable relevant field
evidenceInterpretation: Indirect problem evidence plus observed prototype failures; no measured error rate.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Incomplete analysis or unresolved/conflicting candidate fields produces a needs-context finding.

title: Partial document or page failure
evidenceInterpretation: Broad access/readability context only.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No distinct cropped-page completeness detector in doctor.mjs.

title: Exact duplicate
evidenceInterpretation: Engineering safeguard; no direct applicant complaint established in this review.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Exact duplicate bytes are excluded; similar-looking documents are not automatically duplicates.

title: Amount basis mismatch
evidenceInterpretation: Amount-basis confusion is supported; the precise net/YTD comparison is an engineering interpretation. U05 is Arizona, not CalFresh authority.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Warns when a prepared gross amount equals source net or YTD instead of source gross.

title: Period/request mismatch
evidenceInterpretation: Direct reports about period confusion; county guidance supports contextual period review.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Compares owner-confirmed request scope/period with confirmed record facts; does not invent a universal evidence window.

title: Person or application scope unresolved
evidenceInterpretation: Program separation has policy context; matching algorithm is our design.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Unresolved or mismatched person, program, application or period basis prevents a positive match.

title: Conflicting same-context values
evidenceInterpretation: Official inconsistency context, not a complaint-backed prevalence claim or endorsement of this algorithm.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Requires matching person, issuer, full period and pay date before flagging unequal gross amounts.

title: Previous balance mistaken for current charge
evidenceInterpretation: Issuer-document support; no direct applicant complaint collected for this exact error.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Flags total due used as current charge only with known source amounts, positive previous balance and reconcilable arithmetic.

title: Shared or included expense double count
evidenceInterpretation: Design hypothesis; evidence collection remains open.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No dedicated shared-expense double-count rule in doctor.mjs.

title: Recorded expenses exceed recorded income
evidenceInterpretation: Direct official boundary: discrepancy alone must not imply denial.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Design only; no income-versus-expense sufficiency or fraud check is implemented.

title: Income change/history
evidenceInterpretation: Public changed-employment report and county guidance.
actualBehaviorOrGap: History exists, but automatic employment-change diagnosis is not implemented under PD11.

title: Confirmed county request outstanding
evidenceInterpretation: Reported request/receipt uncertainty plus application-process context.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Keeps a confirmed county request open until a matching response event; a local import is not submission or acceptance.

title: Ambiguous date or pay frequency
evidenceInterpretation: Indirect period/frequency confusion; exact ambiguity detector remains a design hypothesis.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No general ambiguous-date or weekly-versus-semimonthly diagnosis under PD13.

title: Supporting proof not yet added
evidenceInterpretation: Filing distinction and evidence-access barriers.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Official application route remains visible, but no new program-specific proof-deferral engine is implemented.

title: Suggested item with unknown program
evidenceInterpretation: Separate-program principle; exact unknown-suggestion handling is our design.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No distinct PD15 finding emitted.

title: Self-employment expense method
evidenceInterpretation: Strong problem and policy context, but implementation/review remains pending.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No automatic self-employment expense-method election or deduction.

title: Requested care coverage question
evidenceInterpretation: Inherited Medi-Cal navigation reference, not rechecked in this review.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No individualized health-service coverage determination.

title: Notice indicates authorization or denial
evidenceInterpretation: Inherited navigation references, not rechecked in this review.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Notice extraction is not an implemented coverage/appeal diagnosis.

title: Document integrity concern
evidenceInterpretation: Research-only integrity idea; no complaint source or evaluated detector here.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No authenticity or fraud detector.

title: Rule or source stale/unsupported
evidenceInterpretation: Engineering/governance design, not an applicant complaint.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No generic stale-policy finding in doctor.mjs.

title: Specific-program referral
evidenceInterpretation: Inherited referral references, not rechecked in this review.
actualBehaviorOrGap: No automatic condition-based program referral.

title: Transfer snapshot changed
evidenceInterpretation: Engineering protection against stale confirmed information.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Revision-aware transfer invalidation exists in state.mjs; not a PD22 Doctor finding.

title: Receipt type mismatch
evidenceInterpretation: Receipt-status uncertainty and filing distinction; specific type guard is our design.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Receipt-type checks and separate application/upload events exist in state.mjs; no PD23 finding emitted.

title: Unknown document family
evidenceInterpretation: Broad unclear-document evidence plus reader failure handling.
actualBehaviorOrGap: Flags unresolved extracted document kind. It is not directly triggered by the trained classifier score.
